scope: Street entrance/light tower and bounded immediately adjacent left curved return only; no auditorium or whole shop strip.

comparison_findings.evidence: Final front and oblique views show a pale rectangular panelled tower at the left of the entrance with dark stacked GRAND THEATRE letters, matching the characteristic arrangement in daylight and restored-night references.
comparison_findings.limits: Panel spacing, tower width/depth and original symbolic letter strokes are authored approximations. This does not authenticate historic typography or glass construction.

comparison_findings.feature: Tall entrance glazing and projecting fins
comparison_findings.result: initial visible proportion issue resolved in final previews
comparison_findings.evidence: The first previews placed fin tops too far below the tower top. Revised fin tips now rise to roughly three-quarters of the authored tower height, and a bounded recessed upper screen adds the layered wall relationship visible behind the fins in the daylight and restored-night references.
comparison_findings.limits: Fin tops at 22.5 m, rear fin tops at 21.5 m and screen top at 21.0 m are design estimates based on qualitative visual comparison. They are not pixel-derived metric measurements or surveyed heights. Exact fin/bay counts and hidden screen details are not verified.

comparison_findings.evidence: Final front and oblique previews show a broad low canopy over recessed dark framed door glazing. The historical photograph supports this arrangement and a gridded canopy soffit. Source inspection confirms authored underside grid geometry.
comparison_findings.limits: The elevated native camera views do not directly expose the entire canopy underside. Door counts, sizes and miniature canopy lettering are simplified estimates; temporary advertising is omitted.

comparison_findings.evidence: The adjacent left return reads as rounded cream horizontal bands with a small inset window. Its rounded end remains visible beside the tower in both final street-facing previews.
comparison_findings.limits: The crop boundary and return depth are authored, and do not establish parcel boundaries or ownership of the longer street shop strip.

comparison_findings.result: acceptable only as explicit partial-frontage closure
comparison_findings.evidence: The rear preview shows a plain cut closure and bounded roof/screen. No auditorium, complete commercial strip or unrelated taller rear building has been added.
comparison_findings.limits: The reviewed references do not verify these rear surfaces or roof depths. This is not a reconstruction of the theatre rear elevation or a complete freestanding building.

comparison_findings.evidence: Cream bands, pale tower and dark door framing broadly agree with the daylight image. Upper glazing is represented by opaque warm amber panes in the native renders.
comparison_findings.limits: Opaque warm glass appearance is not a physically calibrated or verified daytime material. Night illumination cannot establish daylight color, translucency, emission or reflectance.

revision_history.issue: Upper entrance fins visibly too low relative to tower.
revision_history.requested_change: Increase fin height qualitatively while retaining explicit estimated dimensions; add only the bounded visible upper screen relationship.
revision_history.resolution: Final raw model 62a1c089a0ef27ed305c512774067a79ede4d50794273b36e03bebeece2d94c1 and all three regenerated native previews were actually re-viewed; principal silhouette issue resolved.
